overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics between couples (husband-wife) significantly outperform other topics, driving nearly 10x the views of general poetry or family-member specific content. Content focusing on subtle marital misunderstandings and psychological relationship realities captures maximum engagement.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,678 views) drastically outperformed all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital dynamics, unexpressed expectations, and emotional distance after marriage.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' (391 views) and relationship conflict resolution formats perform better than standalone shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Frame titles around common unspoken arguments or emotional burdens carried inside relationships.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract lines; ground the emotional pain in concrete daily life situations.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister-focused emotional videos ('बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है') stalled at 19 to 139 views compared to parent or spouse dynamics.
weak_patterns.action: Limit sister or sibling content unless tied to a universal psychological friction point.

next_video.hook_style: Direct observation about silent treatment in modern couples
next_video.concept: Kitni ajeeb baat hai na, ladai khatam hone ke baad bhi baatein khatam nahi hotiin. Ek khamoshi ghar mein reh jaati hai.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the specific moment a couple stops arguing and goes to their respective corners of the room, scrolling phones in silence.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that the silence isn't peace; it's two people silently rehearsing how to say sorry without losing their self-respect.
next_video.reason: Aligns with the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship niche, tapping into overthinking and ego in modern bonds.

experiment: Testing whether applying the winning husband-wife relationship framework to the 'overthinking' sub-topic yields higher retention than direct marital advice videos.
